key_fiscal_facts.value_text: ~97-99% govt take (TSC: state owns 100% of oil; contractor earns ~$2/bbl on $70-80/bbl oil = ~1-3%)
Iraq KRG PSC cost recovery ceiling 80% (highest-cost qualifying projects; standard 40-45% cost oil cap per PSC model). Per EY 2024.
35% CIT — Iraq federal corporate income tax rate on contractor fee income
15% KRG regional government carried interest in standard PSC blocks
~1,000,000-1,100,000 bbl/day baseline (approximate Rumaila plateau at 2009 contract signing)
BP/CNPC Rumaila TSC Round 1 bid price 2009; lowest winning bid; paid on incremental production above ~1.0M bbl/day baseline
